Fist Miller is a dwarven fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Lower City in Act Three.
“
Keep crime reports short - do not waste our time with frivolous issues.
„
— Miller

Involvement

Miller is guarding the door to the office at the Basilisk Gate Barracks. If spoken to, he suggests the player character not to engage in any funny business so that the amount of complaints on misdoings was smaller. Also, Miller has a unique greeting for the Half-Orc characters.

Companion approval

If  Counsellor Florrick is executed, the dialogue with Miller is more substantial[1] and might bring some approval/disapproval points from various companions:

  • Miller
    Take heed, citizen - the traitor Florrick swings in the square. She won't be missed.
    • Good riddance.  +1  -1  -1  -1  -1  +1  -1  +1  +1  -2
    • She didn't deserve to die.  -1  +1  +1  +1  +1  -1  +1  +1  +1  +2
